title: ledger.recon_break
description: A reconciliation run found a break (C03 §9-10). Published by the ledger module on NATS subject evt.ledger.recon_break (version 1), one event per break, in the same transaction as the run that found it. Consumer: C15 alerts finance; any break pages on-call (NFR-S4). The fields match the admin breaks list (GET /v1/admin/reconciliation/breaks). This is the `data` payload; the envelope (event_id, type, version, tenant_id, occurred_at, trace_id) is TD-02 §5. New fields are additive only.

run_id.description: The reconciliation run that found it

kind.description: Internal: the ledger against itself (C03 §9.1). Provider and regulator runs come later (B8, B10)

provider.description: The payment provider of a provider run; null otherwise

business_date.description: The business date reconciled, a calendar day in East Africa Time

reference.description: What broke. Internal runs: account:{code} (a house or provider account), account:{code}:{player_id}, account_id:{uuid} (entries for an account that doesn't exist), txn:{uuid}, or ledger (all entries together)

expected_santim.description: What the entries say, in santim (normal orientation for accounts); null when there is nothing to compare with

actual_santim.description: What the account or transaction shows, in santim

note.description: The check that failed, in words, for finance
